query: Which counterfactual methods (synthetic control, matched portfolios, Bayesian time series) are most robust to selection bias from narrative-driven deal flow?

response.query: Which counterfactual methods (synthetic control, matched portfolios, Bayesian time series) are most robust to selection bias from narrative-driven deal flow?
response.answer: Synthetic control methods are most robust to selection bias from narrative-driven deal flow. Matched portfolios and Bayesian time series are less effective in this context.
